articles.title: A LatAm telecom operator is putting part of its finances on Avalanche
articles.snippet: Led by former IBM Blockchain partner Jules Miller, Iris is helping Bolivia's VIVA use stablecoins for settlement, dollar reserves and new financial services without replacing its existing telecom systems.

articles.title: Bitcoin traders brace for Fed hike, but a surprise hold could pose bigger risk
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is stuck near $80,000 as traders build stablecoin positions that could return to the market once Fed uncertainty clears.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank close to debuting crypto custody for institutions
articles.snippet: The service will support a select range of cryptocurrencies at debut, including bitcoin and ether and stablecoins like USDC and EURC.

articles.title: Circle debuts Arc blockchain which Jeremy Allaire calls ‘more consequential’ than USDC
articles.snippet: The USDC issuer's chain is built for payments, tokenized assets and institutional finance as banks and payment giants pile into the stablecoin market.

articles.title: US House tax committee advances crypto tax overhaul in 38–5 vote
articles.snippet: A bipartisan House committee vote advanced legislation that would reshape federal tax rules for stablecoins, staking, crypto lending and digital asset transactions.
